review_text: Do not believe the pictures you see on the advertisements & front pages of the private villa. The private villa doesn't have a beach access in front as it is shown on the pictures. It was apprently the case before but now there are some construction work currently on-going which resulted with full shoreline filled with rocks, so there is no beachfront or ocean access from this villa. And we learned this the hard way after arrival and the owners didn't agree that all the advertisements and the pictures were misleading. We believe the owners %100 should have communicated this issue before we did the booking. On the booking you'd see they mention there might be some "sound" issues due to construction but no other means of reflecting the truth, still while looking at the page for this villa I am sure people would believe the villa has direct beach access. Since it was a suprise to us I hope in the future people would go there knowing this issue. The villa itself is okay, one issue is it is not isolated from outside properly, so be cautious of centipedes/geckos/bugs entering the house through the many gaps all around the villa. Service was all friendly and good people, no complains to that.

I had an absolutely terrible experience at Kosone Hostel, largely due to Wann and his manager. The way they handle bar tabs is completely disorganized and honestly shocking. There seems to be zero system in place to properly track who owes what, which led to me being accused of a bill that wasn’t even mine. Instead of calmly resolving the situation, they immediately escalated things in the worst possible way—making aggressive accusations, threatening deportation, and even going as far as following me around town demanding payment. It felt intimidating, unprofessional, and completely out of line for any hospitality business. This was an absolute nightmare and easily some of the worst behavior I’ve ever experienced while traveling. No guest should ever feel harassed or unsafe over what was clearly their own internal mistake. I would strongly advise anyone to stay far away from this place unless you want to deal with chaos and confrontation instead of a relaxing stay.

I tell him, he finds it out, he doesn't look at his emails apparently... but it doesn't affect him at all. The room is not ready, leftover food, empty water bottles, but he tells us that the sheets are clean (hum hum...) and that we are going to make a king size bed by sticking the two small beds . (the reservation is with a large bed for two, it’s obviously different and if you know that you can book elsewhere) He cleans quickly (not even the toilets!) and tells us that everything is fine even if we waited 1 hour. I told him what I thought of it, there are limits. His only excuse: "I had a ceremony (Hindu, full moon)". The fridge is empty instead of having several bottles of water, coke, beers as shown in the photo (in amed after 9 p.m., it's complicated to buy water..) The wifi does not work (even with the correct code), the toilets are leaking do the outside pump never stops. And icing on the cake there is a bar next to these rooms with a live show on Saturday evening until late. And (early) in the morning the fishermen who pull up their boats on the beach with a very noisy engine just in front of the room! Clearly, the quiet room on the beach it’s not there ! The next day he suggests that we change rooms, and there the fridge doesn't work at all, so we don't change. I'm so sick of this guy. Sad because the place could be wonderful if it was managed. Once, not twice, never again with this guy! Too bad because I come every month for a few nights and I'm just looking for the place where I'm going to go each time. But not there for sure.

The lady taking care of us, Misha, doesn’t really understand empathy or professionalism. Whenever we raise an issue, she keeps saying, “But everyone loves this place, it’s rated five stars.” We’ve traveled to many countries and stayed in numerous places, but we’ve never felt so misunderstood. When you arrive, you’ll see that the website only mentions “there might be noise due to work”, but it doesn’t explain what kind of work — and yet they’re charging a fortune. They’ll say there’s a private transfer to Virgin Beach, but that’s only because it’s not actually beachfront as advertised. There are massive rocks in front of the house, not sand, so they have to drive you there. There are many other places where you can swim right in front of your accommodation and in much better locations — all for the same price. Don’t let these people take advantage of you after you’ve waited all year and saved up for this trip.
